name: omp-extension-guard
description: An oh-my-pi (omp) package that keeps unreviewed extension code from running in omp's process: a read-only inventory of every module omp would load at startup, a signed list of approved extensions, a launcher (omp-ext-safe) that checks credential exposure and starts omp with only the approved extensions, and a guard that keeps the agent from planting code where omp auto-loads it.
